snippet.title: Kidbash: Super Legend - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: In this nostalgic roguelike action-platformer, awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and rediscover the true meaning of being a hero? Watch the latest Kidbash: Super Legend trailer to see action-packed gameplay and more. Kidbash will be available on PC.
